title: drabella muralis
intro: Drabella muralis, commonly known as False Flax or Wild Flax, is a perennial plant native to Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its edible seeds, which are a rich source of omega-3 fatty acids and have been used for centuries to promote health and well-being. The health benefits of Drabella muralis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support digestive health, making it a popular ingredient in herbal supplements. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
